targeting.title: n8n Merge Node: Fix Waiting Issues, Combine Modes and SQL Joins
targeting.metaTitle: n8n Merge Node: Waiting Fixes, Modes and SQL
targeting.metaDescription: Fix the n8n Merge node when it never runs or drops items. See what each mode does with an empty branch, v0 vs v1 execution order, and tested SQL joins.
targeting.excerpt: A source-checked n8n Merge node guide: how the engine decides when a waiting Merge runs, what Append, Combine, SQL Query and Choose Branch do when one branch is empty, v0 versus v1 execution order, executed AlaSQL join examples and a repair table for the usual errors.
targeting.keywords: n8n merge node, n8n merge node not working, n8n merge node wait for all inputs, n8n merge node append, n8n merge node sql, n8n merge node example, n8n combine by matching fields, n8n execution order v0 vs v1, n8n merge three inputs, n8n merge node empty input
targeting.summary: Pick the Merge mode by data shape: Append after an If split, Matching Fields for keyed joins, SQL Query for three or more inputs|In the v1 execution order a Merge runs with an empty input for a branch that produced nothing, except Choose Branch, which never runs|SQL mode needs bracketed reserved words, explicit aliases for shared columns and node version 3.2 for the Empty Query Result option

research.selection: Ran 48 n8n seeds through Google public autocomplete on 15 November 2026. The Merge node cluster returned a full set of ten troubleshooting-flavoured suggestions (not working, wait for all inputs, example, append, wait, sql, binary, sql query) and ties directly into the published item linking, Loop Over Items and Split Out guides. Error handling, Schedule Trigger and HTTP pagination were the runner-up clusters and remain open for later posts. Existing search results include the official docs, community threads, GitHub issues and several blog guides, so this is not a low-competition claim; the differentiator is an engine-level explanation grounded in the pinned source commit plus executed SQL examples including failure cases.

primarySourceNotes: Merge v3 versionDescription declares requiredInputs as [0, 1] for chooseBranch and 1 for every other mode; default node version 3.2; versions 3, 3.1, 3.2 share the implementation.

workflow-execute.ts: in v1 a child is only scheduled when the output array has items (or, under legacy order, when connected to input index > 0); addWaitingNodeToEmptyStack fills missing inputs with [] and honours requiredInputs; forceInputNodeExecution is true only outside v1.

combineByPosition.ts: item count is the minimum across inputs unless includeUnpaired; zero rows adds the hint about Include Any Unpaired Items; without the clash option the last input wins; the option preset is addSuffix.

combineByFields.ts: keepMatches with an empty input returns [] (no output, children not scheduled); enrichInput1 with empty input1 returns []; otherwise the non-empty input is passed through; items missing the match field go to unmatched; multipleMatches default 'all'; joinMode default keepMatches; strict compare unless fuzzyCompare.

combineBySql.ts: tables input1..inputN, isolated-vm sandbox with memory limit and 30000 ms timeout, error messages 'Dataset too large for the SQL sandbox', 'SQL query exceeded the 30 second execution limit', 'Issue while executing query'; success item only for typeVersion <= 3.1 or emptyQueryResult === 'success'; parameters validated as string/number/boolean/null.

AlaSQL 4.4.0 (declared by packages/nodes-base) parse-fails on unquoted total and plan; brackets and backticks work; SELECT * keeps the later table's value for shared column names; = compares loosely so 101 matches '101'.
n8n docs: Merge node overhauled in 0.194.0; more than two inputs and SQL Query from 1.49.0; Empty Query Result from 1.95.0 on node version 3.2; legacy v0 forces the other If branch to execute.
